steps.name: Force kill during operation
steps.action: Kill Catalogizer desktop process while browsing library
steps.expected: Process terminates immediately

steps.name: Relaunch app
steps.action: Launch Catalogizer desktop again
steps.expected: App launches normally, previous state partially restored, no corruption errors

steps.name: Disconnect network
steps.action: Disable all network interfaces
steps.expected: Network is down

steps.name: Launch app
steps.action: Start Catalogizer desktop
steps.expected: App launches, shows connection error with retry button, no crash

steps.name: Enter invalid URL
steps.action: Set server URL to 'not-a-url' in settings
steps.expected: Validation error shown, URL not saved

steps.name: Enter XSS payload
steps.action: Set server URL to '<script>alert(1)</script>' in settings
steps.expected: Input sanitized, no script execution, validation error displayed

steps.name: Trigger long IPC operation
steps.action: Request large file operation via IPC
steps.expected: Operation times out gracefully with user-friendly error, app remains responsive

steps.name: Flood IPC
steps.action: Send 100 IPC commands in rapid succession
steps.expected: Commands are queued or debounced, app does not hang or crash

steps.name: Load large library
steps.action: Open library view with 100,000+ media items
steps.expected: Virtual scrolling active, UI remains responsive, memory usage bounded

steps.name: Resize to minimum
steps.action: Resize window to 200x200 pixels
steps.expected: Content adapts gracefully, no overflow, minimum size enforced or scrollbars appear

steps.name: Corrupt config
steps.action: Replace app config file with invalid JSON
steps.expected: App launches with defaults, warns about corrupted config, does not crash

steps.name: Trigger save with no disk space
steps.action: Attempt to save config when disk is full
steps.expected: Error displayed to user, no data corruption, previous config preserved

steps.name: Launch second instance
steps.action: Try to launch Catalogizer while it is already running
steps.expected: Either prevents second instance or brings existing window to focus

steps.name: Connect to server with bad cert
steps.action: Configure server URL with self-signed cert that doesn't match hostname
steps.expected: Warning displayed about certificate issue, connection not silently allowed

steps.name: Launch with old token
steps.action: Launch app after stored JWT has expired
steps.expected: Token refresh attempted, if fails redirect to login page cleanly

steps.name: Switch theme during load
steps.action: Toggle dark/light mode while library is loading
steps.expected: Theme switches smoothly, loading continues, no visual artifacts

steps.name: Search with regex chars
steps.action: Enter '.*+?^${}()|[]\' in search field
steps.expected: Search treated as literal text, no regex evaluation, results shown or empty state

steps.name: Drop invalid file
steps.action: Drag and drop a .exe file onto the media library
steps.expected: File rejected with appropriate message, no processing attempted

steps.name: System sleeps
steps.action: Put system to sleep while app is running
steps.expected: No error

steps.name: System wakes
steps.action: Wake system from sleep
steps.expected: App resumes, reconnects to server, refreshes data

steps.name: Paste binary clipboard
steps.action: Copy binary content and paste into search field
steps.expected: Binary data handled gracefully, no crash, search field shows safe text or empty

steps.name: Set 200% scaling
steps.action: Run app on 200% DPI scaled display
steps.expected: All UI elements properly scaled, no blurry text, no clipped elements

steps.name: Connect via proxy
steps.action: Configure system HTTP proxy and launch app
steps.expected: App respects system proxy settings or shows proxy configuration option

steps.name: Navigate with keyboard only
steps.action: Navigate all screens using only Tab, Enter, Escape, Arrow keys
steps.expected: All interactive elements reachable, focus visible, actions performable without mouse

challenges.name: Files with Unicode Names in Library

steps.name: Display unicode filenames
steps.action: Browse library containing files with Chinese, Arabic, emoji characters in names
steps.expected: All filenames render correctly, no mojibake, sorting works

steps.name: Start multiple ops
steps.action: Trigger search, scan, and download simultaneously
steps.expected: All operations proceed independently, UI shows progress for each, no deadlocks

steps.name: Simulate update failure
steps.action: Trigger auto-update check when update server is unreachable
steps.expected: Error shown gracefully, app continues working normally, retry option available

steps.name: Close window to tray
steps.action: Close the main window with minimize-to-tray enabled
steps.expected: Window closes, tray icon remains, app still accessible from tray

steps.name: Restore from tray
steps.action: Click tray icon to restore window
steps.expected: Window restores to previous size and position
